The wood appears to be a medium-dark stain with a glossy finish. The perspective is slightly angled, showing the depth of the shelves.

To rigorously quantify the legibility and coherence of text on book spines, a common failure point in AI images.
To check for individual book segmentation errors, such as books fusing together or floating off shelves.
To assess general sharpness, lighting consistency, and detect any subtle global distortions.
